## Batting Average
- Batting average is a measure of a batsman's performance, calculated by dividing the total number of runs scored by the number of times they have been dismissed. A higher batting average indicates a more consistent and successful batsman.

## Strike Rate
- In batting, strike rate indicates the scoring rate of a batsman, showing the average number of runs scored per 100 balls faced. A higher strike rate reflects an aggressive and fast-scoring batsman.

- Wickets taken refers to the total number of times a bowler has successfully dismissed an opposing batsman. This statistic is a core measure of a bowler's effectiveness and impact on the game.

- Economy rate measures a bowler's efficiency by indicating the average number of runs conceded per over (6 balls) bowled. A lower economy rate shows greater control and efficiency in restricting the opposition's scoring.

WITH player_roles AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM ipl.main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
ranked_roles AS (
    SELECT player_id, role,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
    FROM player_roles
),
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role as most_frequent_role
    FROM ranked_roles
    WHERE rn = 1
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as total_matches
    FROM ipl.main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM ipl.main.wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),
ball_level_batting AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.striker as player_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.ball_id,
        b.innings_no,
        COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) as runs_scored
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored s
        ON b.match_id = s.match_id
        AND b.over_id = s.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = s.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = s.innings_no
),
match_level_batting AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) as match_runs,
        COUNT(*) as match_balls_faced
    FROM ball_level_batting
    GROUP BY player_id, match_id
),
player_batting_agg AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        SUM(match_runs) as total_runs,
        MAX(match_runs) as highest_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_30_plus,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_50_plus,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_100_plus,
        SUM(match_balls_faced) as total_balls_faced
    FROM match_level_batting
    GROUP BY player_id
),
ball_level_bowling AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.bowler as player_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.ball_id,
        b.innings_no,
        COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) as runs_scored,
        CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'lbw', 'caught and bowled', 'stumped', 'hit wicket') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_wicket
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored s
        ON b.match_id = s.match_id
        AND b.over_id = s.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = s.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = s.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.wicket_taken w
        ON b.match_id = w.match_id
        AND b.over_id = w.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
),
match_level_bowling AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) as match_runs_conceded,
        SUM(is_wicket) as match_wickets,
        COUNT(*) as match_balls_bowled
    FROM ball_level_bowling
    GROUP BY player_id, match_id
),
player_bowling_agg AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        SUM(match_runs_conceded) as total_runs_conceded,
        SUM(match_wickets) as total_wickets,
        SUM(match_balls_bowled) as total_balls_bowled
    FROM match_level_bowling
    GROUP BY player_id
),
ranked_best_bowling AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        match_wickets,
        match_runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_wickets DESC, match_runs_conceded ASC) as rn
    FROM match_level_bowling
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        CAST(match_wickets AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(match_runs_conceded AS VARCHAR) as best_bowling_performance
    FROM ranked_best_bowling
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(pba.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    COALESCE(pm.total_matches, 0) as total_matches,
    COALESCE(pd.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    COALESCE(pba.total_runs, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(pd.total_dismissals, 0) as batting_average,
    COALESCE(pba.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
    COALESCE(pba.matches_30_plus, 0) as matches_30_plus,
    COALESCE(pba.matches_50_plus, 0) as matches_50_plus,
    COALESCE(pba.matches_100_plus, 0) as matches_100_plus,
    COALESCE(pba.total_balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    COALESCE(pba.total_runs, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(pba.total_balls_faced, 0) as strike_rate,

args.sql:
WITH player_roles AS (
    SELECT player_id, role, COUNT(*) as cnt
    FROM ipl.main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id, role
),
ranked_roles AS (
    SELECT player_id, role,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY cnt DESC) as rn
    FROM player_roles
),
most_frequent_role AS (
    SELECT player_id, role as most_frequent_role
    FROM ranked_roles
    WHERE rn = 1
),
player_matches AS (
    SELECT player_id, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) as total_matches
    FROM ipl.main.player_match
    GROUP BY player_id
),
player_dismissals AS (
    SELECT player_out as player_id, COUNT(*) as total_dismissals
    FROM ipl.main.wicket_taken
    GROUP BY player_out
),
ball_level_batting AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.striker as player_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.ball_id,
        b.innings_no,
        COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) as runs_scored
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored s
        ON b.match_id = s.match_id
        AND b.over_id = s.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = s.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = s.innings_no
),
match_level_batting AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) as match_runs,
        COUNT(*) as match_balls_faced
    FROM ball_level_batting
    GROUP BY player_id, match_id
),
player_batting_agg AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        SUM(match_runs) as total_runs,
        MAX(match_runs) as highest_score,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_30_plus,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 50 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_50_plus,
        SUM(CASE WHEN match_runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as matches_100_plus,
        SUM(match_balls_faced) as total_balls_faced
    FROM match_level_batting
    GROUP BY player_id
),
ball_level_bowling AS (
    SELECT
        b.match_id,
        b.bowler as player_id,
        b.over_id,
        b.ball_id,
        b.innings_no,
        COALESCE(s.runs_scored, 0) as runs_scored,
        CASE WHEN w.kind_out IN ('bowled', 'caught', 'lbw', 'caught and bowled', 'stumped', 'hit wicket') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_wicket
    FROM ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.batsman_scored s
        ON b.match_id = s.match_id
        AND b.over_id = s.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = s.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = s.innings_no
    LEFT JOIN ipl.main.wicket_taken w
        ON b.match_id = w.match_id
        AND b.over_id = w.over_id
        AND b.ball_id = w.ball_id
        AND b.innings_no = w.innings_no
),
match_level_bowling AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        match_id,
        SUM(runs_scored) as match_runs_conceded,
        SUM(is_wicket) as match_wickets,
        COUNT(*) as match_balls_bowled
    FROM ball_level_bowling
    GROUP BY player_id, match_id
),
player_bowling_agg AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        SUM(match_runs_conceded) as total_runs_conceded,
        SUM(match_wickets) as total_wickets,
        SUM(match_balls_bowled) as total_balls_bowled
    FROM match_level_bowling
    GROUP BY player_id
),
ranked_best_bowling AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        match_wickets,
        match_runs_conceded,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY match_wickets DESC, match_runs_conceded ASC) as rn
    FROM match_level_bowling
),
best_bowling AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        CAST(match_wickets AS VARCHAR) || '-' || CAST(match_runs_conceded AS VARCHAR) as best_bowling_performance
    FROM ranked_best_bowling
    WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
    p.player_id,
    p.player_name,
    mfr.most_frequent_role,
    p.batting_hand,
    p.bowling_skill,
    COALESCE(pba.total_runs, 0) as total_runs,
    COALESCE(pm.total_matches, 0) as total_matches,
    COALESCE(pd.total_dismissals, 0) as total_dismissals,
    COALESCE(pba.total_runs, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(pd.total_dismissals, 0) as batting_average,
    COALESCE(pba.highest_score, 0) as highest_score,
    COALESCE(pba.matches_30_plus, 0) as matches_30_plus,
    COALESCE(pba.matches_50_plus, 0) as matches_50_plus,
    COALESCE(pba.matches_100_plus, 0) as matches_100_plus,
    COALESCE(pba.total_balls_faced, 0) as total_balls_faced,
    COALESCE(pba.total_runs, 0) * 100.0 / NULLIF(pba.total_balls_faced, 0) as strike_rate,
    COALESCE(pbo.total_wickets, 0) as total_wickets,
    COALESCE(pbo.total_runs_conceded, 0) * 6.0 / NULLIF(pbo.total_balls_bowled, 0) as economy_rate,
    bb.best_bowling_performance
FROM ipl.main.player p
LEFT JOIN most_frequent_role mfr ON p.player_id = mfr.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_matches pm ON p.player_id = pm.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_dismissals pd ON p.player_id = pd.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_batting_agg pba ON p.player_id = pba.player_id
LEFT JOIN player_bowling_agg pbo ON p.player_id = pbo.player_id
